description: Test cases for the CLI root command of the agentfield project, including environment setup, flag management, and configuration handling.

methods.name: resetCLIStateForTest
methods.description: Resets global CLI state flags to default values before each test.

methods.name: TestRootCommandDisplaysHelp
methods.description: Verifies that the root command displays help information correctly.

methods.name: TestRootCommandServerFlags
methods.description: Checks that server-related flags are correctly parsed and their effects are applied.
